categories.main_business_segments: Muyuan Foods Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pig farming and pork processing industry. Its main business segments include pig breeding and sales, slaughtering, and meat product sales. The company has a vertically integrated business model covering feed processing, pig breeding, pig farming, slaughtering, and meat product distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding technologies including a dual-line breeding system and genetic evaluation to improve pig quality and reduce disease risk. It utilizes intelligent farming technologies such as smart ventilation, feeding, and environmental control systems to enhance production efficiency and biosecurity. Feed production incorporates optimized nutrition formulas and low-soy diets to reduce costs and environmental impact. Automated and intelligent slaughtering and meat processing lines are also used to ensure product quality and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Muyuan Foods serves a broad range of customers including institutional buyers, wholesalers, retailers, and individual consumers across China. Its products include commercial pigs, piglets, breeding pigs, and processed pork products such as chilled and frozen meat cuts. The company’s markets are primarily domestic, covering 25 provinces in China with a growing presence in meat product distribution networks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with pig farming and slaughtering facilities distributed in 24-25 provinces. It has established a nationwide pork sales network with service stations in 20 provinces. The registered office and headquarters are located in Nanyang, Henan Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Muyuan Foods operates as an integrated player covering upstream (feed production and pig breeding), midstream (pig farming), and downstream (slaughtering and meat processing) segments of the pork supply chain. This vertical integration allows full control over production, quality, and cost management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in breeding technology, nutrition optimization, disease prevention, and intelligent farming systems. R&D focuses on developing high-quality breeding stock, precision nutrition models, smart feeding and environmental control, and automated slaughtering processes. It also invests in green technologies such as ammonia reduction and renewable energy (solar power) to support sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Muyuan Foods generates revenue primarily through the sale of live pigs (commercial pigs, piglets, breeding pigs) and processed pork products. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or weigh-out. The company also earns income from feed sales and other related agricultural products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Muyuan Foods is one of the leading pig farming and pork processing companies in China, with a significant market share in a fragmented industry. It competes with other large-scale integrated pork producers and benefits from its vertical integration, scale, and technological advantages. The company is positioned as a high-quality, cost-efficient producer with strong biosecurity and food safety controls.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Muyuan Foods achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 137.95 billion, representing a 24.43% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 18.9 billion, a significant turnaround from losses in prior years. The company operates 312 subsidiaries and has an annual pig farming capacity of about 81 million heads and slaughtering capacity of 29 million heads. Cash flow from operations increased substantially, reflecting strong growth and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Muyuan Foods emphasizes food safety, product quality, and traceability through its vertically integrated model. It offers consumers high-quality, safe, and affordable pork products with full traceability from breeding to retail. The company’s technological innovations in breeding, nutrition, and intelligent farming reduce costs and improve animal health, supporting sustainable and green production. Its comprehensive quality control systems and certifications further differentiate its products in the market.
